article.headline: Princeton defeats Vermont 75-69 in OT to end 8-game losing streak
article.description: — Jack Stanton had 19 points and Malik Abdullahi scored four in an 8-0 run to begin overtime as Princeton rallied to beat Vermont 75-69 on Tuesday to snap an eight-game losing streak.
article.linkText: Princeton defeats Vermont 75-69 in OT to end 8-game losing streak

article.story: PRINCETON, N.J. -- — Jack Stanton had 19 points and Malik Abdullahi scored four in an 8-0 run to begin overtime as Princeton rallied to beat Vermont 75-69 on Tuesday to snap an eight-game losing streak. Stanton added five assists for the Tigers (4-11). Jackson Hicke totaled 17 points, six rebounds and five assists. Abdullahi shot 5 of 5 from the field and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. The Catamounts (8-7) were led by TJ Long, who recorded 30 points, nine rebounds and three steals. Gus Yalden added 14 points and four assists and TJ Hurley scored 10. Princeton took a 36-32 lead into halftime. Long had a layup with 21 seconds left to force the extra period tied at 63. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
